title: Peaceful Silverfish
description: Peaceful Silverfish lets silverfish spawn from vanilla infested stone even on Peaceful. Great for Create farms and contraptions, but works perfect in vanilla too. Includes an option to mute silverfish sounds so your base stays quiet.
body:
Peaceful Silverfish is a simple little mod that lets silverfish still pop out of vanilla infested stone, even when you are playing on Peaceful.

It is awesome as a Create mod add on because your silverfish farms and contraptions keep working without you having to turn the world into a hostile mob circus. It is also great as a stand alone vanilla style mod for anyone who just wants silverfish mechanics without dealing with creepers, skeletons, and all that mess.

And yes, it also has an option to mute silverfish sounds, so if the clicking and skittering makes you wanna lose it, you can silence them and live in peace.

No custom recipes, no weird changes, just infested stone on Peaceful, plus optional muting.
